title: Roast Meat
instructions: Rub meat with salt,  mace, and pepper. Pour vinegar over it and let stand over night, or four hours. Cut up peppers,  onions, and tomatoes. Place meat in roasting pan, cover with the vegetables, and roast until meat is tender, basting every fifteen minutes with vegetables.
